bi.note: Local model · natural language only; code, paths and links stay as-is
set.title: Chain-of-thought translation
set.intro: Translate reasoning into Chinese next to the original text. Translations are display-only and never written back to the session.
set.enabledHint: When off, reasoning blocks show their original text only.
set.modeHint: Semi-auto: translate when you expand a reasoning block. Auto: translate as soon as reasoning completes, even while collapsed.
set.targetHint: Translate into this language (30+ supported by Hy-MT2; takes effect immediately). Defaults to the client language when the plugin was installed.
set.modelHint: The bundled 1.8B is the fallback. Larger models are more accurate but slower and use more VRAM.
set.sessionModel: Translate with the current conversation model
set.sessionModelHint: Uses the model selected for this conversation (faster, no VRAM), costs API calls; the local model stays the fallback.
set.selftestHint: Runs a fixed sample through the current chain and reports the average time per segment.
set.thirdParty: Third-party: Hy-MT2 models (Apache-2.0, © Tencent Hunyuan) · llama.cpp (MIT)
set.portHint: Loopback port for llama-server (1024–65535). Default 28457, deliberately uncommon; the next translation restarts the server on the new port.
set.portBusy: Port is used by another program
set.portInvalid: Port must be an integer between 1024 and 65535
set.cacheHint: Translations are cached locally (translations only — source text is never written to disk). Restarts reuse them. Cap {limit}; the oldest entries are evicted automatically.
model.note.bundled: Bundled fallback model (cannot delete); fastest, ~1.5 GB VRAM
model.note.q8: Higher precision, ~2.3 GB VRAM, a bit slower
model.note.7b: Best quality, ~4.5 GB VRAM, 3–5× slower than 1.8B
